module: Node "StartScreen Rally Settings" (repeat_instant, color ui). Adds a "coDriverSelector" panel to the start screen of a rally mission: co-driver choice (voicepack), visual notes checkbox and boolean settings (rallyRepairVehicleOnRecovery, rallyEnableFalseStarts, rallyEnableEarlyTimeControlPenalties). Plays an audio sample of the chosen co-driver. The choices are stored as pending and applied on clicking Start (onUIStartButtonClicked hook). Also handles the "rallyLoop" mode. Input flow, output flow (chainFlow).
notes: The file's local functions handle the audio sample: intercomCheckAudioObjs, composedSampleAudioObjs, recordedSampleAudioObjs (reference mission automation_test_track/rallyStage/002-mixedstage, pacenote_27.ogg).
The file depends on gameplay/rally/voicepack, util, audioManager and compositors/helpers/textCompositor.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

init.desc: Creates the panel {type='coDriverSelector', ...} and clears the pending choices.

getMission.desc: Returns the rally mission of the loop (loopManager:getRallyLoopMission()) or, without a loop, the manager's activity.

buildLoopOptions.desc: Builds the list of co-drivers for a rally loop mission (label, value, shortLabel, detail) and the selected value; returns nil if nothing is available.

buildStageOptions.desc: Same for a standard rally special stage from the rally manager.

buildBoolSettings.desc: Returns the mission's boolean settings kept in settingKeys, with the pending value if it exists.

work.desc: Builds the panel (co-driver options, selection, visual notes, boolean settings, loop note) and adds it to the UI, then plays the intercom test of the selected co-driver. Without a rally manager or without options, logs a warning and skips the panel.

resolveEntry.desc: Finds the voicepack entry matching the chosen value (loop or special stage mode).

playSample.desc: Resets the sample audio queue then puts the given audio objects in it (voicepack timing of the entry).

audioObjs.desc: Audio objects to play; nil to stop.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame as an extension; advances the sample audio queue.

onCoDriverSelectedByPanel.desc: Called by the panel when a co-driver is chosen: stores the choice and plays a sample (composed, recorded or intercom test).

onVisualPacenotesChangedByPanel.desc: Called when the visual notes checkbox changes; stores rallyVisualPacenotes as pending.

onRallyStartSettingChanged.desc: Called when a boolean setting changes: updates pendingSettings, mission.lastUserSettings and the panel. Accepts either (key, value) or a table {key, value}.

onUIStartButtonClicked.desc: Hook called on clicking Start: stops the audio, writes the pending settings via settings.setValue and applies the chosen co-driver (applyPick).

applyPick.desc: Applies the co-driver choice: records rallyVoicepackPick (loop) or reloads the voicepack assets via rm:reloadVoicepackAssets; logs an error on failure.
